summary:
Here are the key developments with insight:

• **Retell uses OpenAI models to reach $1.6M annual revenue run rate per employee**: Retell has successfully deployed OpenAI models, specifically GPT-6 Astra and Codex, to power 100M monthly calls, achieving a significant revenue milestone of $1.6M annual revenue run rate per employee. This showcase highlights the commercial success of using OpenAI technology in call centers and contact centers.

• **Oracle and OpenAI expand partnership**: Oracle and OpenAI have expanded their partnership to bring business applications and AI agents into ChatGPT and power new Oracle offerings. This expanded partnership demonstrates the growing collaboration between key players in the tech industry to integrate AI and chatbots into their products and services.

• **Daybreak accelerates Check Point's vulnerability research**: Check Point has leveraged OpenAI's Daybreak to speed up the research behind new security protections, enabling analysts to turn vulnerability intelligence into customer defenses faster. This highlights the importance of AI-assisted research in the cybersecurity field.

• **Anima reduces call waits by 75%**: Anima has successfully deployed GPT-6 and GPT-Live to reduce call waits by 75% for clinics, demonstrating the potential of AI in improving customer service and patient care experiences.

• **Localiza reorganizes work with generative AI**: Localiza has implemented OpenAI's ChatGPT Enterprise, API, Codex, and 60+ specialized agents to reorganize work and create AI-native mobility experiences. This showcases the adoption of generative AI in innovative industries.

Trend: **Increased adoption of OpenAI technology across industries**: The news highlights various companies across different industries, such as customer service (Retell), business applications (Oracle), cybersecurity (Check Point), healthcare (Anima), and mobility (Localiza), leveraging OpenAI technology to enhance their products, services, and experiences. This trend underscores the growing acceptance and adoption of AI-driven solutions across the market.
